setupWizardTheMost: Setup wizard: the most important settings for a first start, step by step.
theseChoicesAreSaved: These choices are saved with your circle, so every device you sign in on shows the same.
showAPictureNext: Show a picture next to each message
yourOneSPicture: Your {{ one }}'s picture and yours, in a conversation.
shiftEnterMakesA: Shift + Enter makes a new line. Off: Enter makes a new line and Ctrl + Enter sends.
offAOneYou: Off: nobody new is added to the sleep list. Those already on it stay there, quiet, until you wake or delete them.
acceptAutomaticallyHint: Off: you confirm each request yourself. On: someone with a verified email or phone becomes your friend at once, without asking you. Others still wait for you. With all seats taken they go on the sleep list, or wait for a seat if you use no sleep list.
tellWhenIAdd: Tell them when I add something to the safebox
aMessageTellsYour: A message tells your friend or group that a note, item or file is there, with a link to open it. Off: nothing is sent; the bell in an item can still tell them.
